Application Data.NAME: SecureMail Logistics, Inc.
Application Data.MAILING ADDRESS:
1234 Secure Shipping Lane, Suite 100  
Springfield, IL 62701-2345
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: SecureMail Logistics, Inc. operates as a comprehensive postal and shipping center, specializing in the efficient handling of mail and parcels. Our services include domestic and international shipping, package tracking, and logistics management. We adhere to all postal regulations, including licensing as a USPS-approved shipping agent, and comply with hazardous materials handling protocols. Our facility is equipped with robust physical security measures, including surveillance cameras and secure access controls, ensuring the safety and integrity of all shipments. Moreover, we maintain a rigorous employee screening process to mitigate risks associated with theft and fraud, demonstrating our commitment to operational excellence and customer trust.
